Yusuf Inaugurates APC Caucus Committees in 44 Kano LGAs by LEADERSHIP News 9 seconds ago in News Share on WhatsApp Share on Facebook Share on X Telegram Kano State Governor, Abba Yusuf, has inaugurated the All Progressives Congress caucus committees across the state’s 44 local government areas as part of efforts to strengthen the party ahead of the 2027 general elections.
The governor also disclosed that he had been confirmed as the coordinator of the APC’s presidential and senatorial campaigns in the state.
Yusuf announced this during the inauguration of the committees at the Kano State Government House, where he urged party leaders and members to unite and cooperate to ensure the party’s success in the forthcoming elections.
He said unity and mutual understanding were essential to consolidating the party’s support base and resolving internal differences among its members.
The governor expressed appreciation to party leaders and members for their patience and cooperation in the formation of the committees, describing them as an important structure for strengthening the APC at the grassroots.
He said the committees were constituted with consideration for qualified party members and the roles of relevant leaders to promote fairness and balance within the party.
According to him, the initiative is expected to improve relationships among party stakeholders, address internal disagreements and strengthen coordination of party activities across the state.
Yusuf urged APC leaders in the 44 local government areas to intensify grassroots mobilisation and work together in preparation for the 2027 elections.
He added that plans were underway to inaugurate the state campaign committee, which would mobilise support for the party and communicate its policies, programmes and development agenda to residents.
The governor said the campaign would cover communities and neighbourhoods across the state, rather than being restricted to major urban centres.
He assured party members that the state government and the APC leadership would continue to work with the party’s various structures to ensure effective coordination and an organised campaign ahead of the elections.
